explanation: The value is only nonzero at D1, right after a trial where the agent chose a1 but was taken to S2 (a rare transition): it is about 10 if that trial was unrewarded and the trial before it was rewarded (lower, about 7, early in the episode), about 5-6 if the rare trial was rewarded, and only about 1-2 if the trial before the rare one was also unrewarded. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at D1 after any common transition or after a2 leading to S1.
